column1: # The privilege matrix: what each schema object may be done by which role.
# This file is the single source of truth for fuelflow_app's and fuelflow_maintenance's
# table grants. ensure-database-roles.sh reads it, verifies that every table in the
# public schema is listed (an unlisted table is a deploy failure, not a silent gap),
# and applies exactly these grants - revoking everything else.
#   schema       the schema the object lives in (the matrix covers public only;
#                the hangfire schema belongs to Hangfire and keeps its own blanket grant)
#   app          fuelflow_app's privileges: S=SELECT I=INSERT U=UPDATE D=DELETE,
#                U(col,...) for an update limited to the named columns, "-" for none
#   mutable       SIUD  - ordinary product data; the application owns its lifecycle
#   retention     SIU + maintenance SD - the nightly purge deletes these as
#                 fuelflow_maintenance (DataRetentionService), so a defect in the
#   append-only   SI (+ a narrow column update where a row is "closed" in place) -
#                 audit and ledger records: written once, never rewritten, never deleted
#   migration-only -    - none today (migrator-owned objects carry no app grant)
# WARNING: the blank maintenance column means the maintenance role has NO grants on the
# table - it is not "inherit from app". The roles do not inherit from each other.
